# Star Performance Motor, used car dealer in Yishun, Singapore

> Star Performance Motor Pte. Ltd. (UEN 202223232K, incorporated 9 November 2022) is a used car dealer at 9 Yishun Industrial Street 1, #01-82, North Spring Bizhub, Singapore 768163. Services: buy a used car, sell or trade in your car, consignment, export of cars near COE expiry, and sourcing of specific models. Values: Sincere, Passionate, Mindful. Customers recommend it 100% on Facebook from 391 reviews (as at 17 October 2026); reviewers name Zach, Celsius and Wei Kiat. Live stock with prices is on sgcarmart (https://www.sgcarmart.com/used-cars/listing?dl=3954). Buyers can view and test drive at the showroom and book a pre-purchase inspection at their own workshop. Showroom open 10am to 8pm, every day; Google rating 5.0 from 110 reviews (as at 17 October 2026). WhatsApp or call +65 9742 7491. Facebook https://www.facebook.com/Starperformancemotor/, Instagram https://www.instagram.com/starperformancemotor/. Sister business in the same unit: Wrapstar Autostyle, car wraps and PPF, https://wrapstarautostyle.com/.

Last updated: 10 November 2026.
